placement: Every component is a full-frame 1080x1920 layer mounted as a HyperFrames sub-composition (data-composition-src) with its props as data-variable-values; x, y and w props place the element; the host order and z-index give the stacking; the canvas is mounted first for the whole reel, the caption line once over the body beats.

conventions.times: props in seconds local to the clip (enter_at, exit_at); hero-3d and icon-3d also need clip_start = its data-start
conventions.hold: every element component has hold (calm, normal, lively): the steady motion after its entrance (Motion and energy rules E1); the canvas takes seed and duration
conventions.images: image props take a path relative to the project (assets/brand/... from library/brand per brand.json, assets/research/... from the run's research assets); aspect ratio locked, never redrawn
conventions.exit: every element component has exit (none, fade-blur, fall, push, cut) and exit_at: the scene change of 9c
conventions.honesty: card-like components take honesty (none, mock, sourced) and show the light chip of tokens.json honesty_labels
conventions.kinds: canvas: the background; card: a hero or support card; label: chips; support: badges, bars, strikes, callouts; move: a move demo that is also usable on its own; hook, cta, captions, branding, brand-slot, 3d as named

components.name: Caption word (word mode)
